Hi there,
 
[agent] from Zapier Support here, stepping in for Ed. I've reviewed your escalation and want to address this directly.
 
Regarding your data erasure request: as [agent] mentioned, we need you to delete your Zapier account via https://zapier.com/app/settings/advanced/delete for the account deletion to be finalized. Once that's complete (or if you confirm you're unable to do so), I'll follow up with our internal teams to ensure all associated personal data is fully erased within our 30-day obligation window.
 
We're treating this with appropriate urgency.
There are two steps to the process, one for you and one for us:
 
 
FOR YOU: We’ll need you to delete your Zapier account.  For security reasons, we can’t do this for you.  It doesn't take long, though: just login to zapier.com and follow the instructions at: https://zapier.com/app/settings/advanced/delete.

Once you’ve completed this process, your account and any Zap Workflows or developer integrations built on it will be deleted. This action is irreversible.
Please note that until you delete your Zapier account, personal data of yours will remain on our systems.

 
FOR US: We'll review our internal records and delete personal data of yours consistent with our obligations.

This process may take us up to one month and we’ll write you back once it has been completed.
Deletion of your personal data includes removal from Zapier marketing subscriptions and other related communications that you may be currently receiving. If you choose to reengage with Zapier in the future, then we will once again have personal data about you in our records.
 
We’re sad to see you go but grateful that you’ve given Zapier a try! If there’s anything we can do to help with this situation, please let us know.
 
Best,


--
[agent] - Zapier Support
